_comment: Merged-class -> human label for the nature-types model. Source: combined_dataset_summary.csv (raw grunnkart codes, which match the `class` column in the stable-allyears parquet). Merges applied per the pipeline: 1->2 (bare/rock/sand folded into bare) and 9->8 (marine folded into water). Keys are the 10 effective post-merge class codes the model predicts. Do NOT use conformal_combined_results.json naming here — that file uses a different re-indexed scheme for a different dataset and does not align with this parquet.
